'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Cole Lepine DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Deck name:''' I've played this deck over 1 year
* '''Username:''' clepine
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
